notes: BE counts Payli and Restomax. Third candidate: Fritzy (stored 80a8b5b2, restaurant/friterie tool) re-read today: 0 € a month + 0,90 € HTVA per online order, pickup time on the ticket. Doubt for the reviewer: customers order 'sur l'app et sur fritzy.be' - a shared Fritzy app/site listing friteries, so it is close to a marketplace, though the business pays a fixed per-order fee, not a commission. Food-truck alternative Digitaste (stored 0e42d25f) has no price (configurator only, compare-research-1) - not re-read. Stopped at 3 if Fritzy is accepted.
